title.ko: exprimer l'avenir : aller + inf., futur simple, présent, j'aimerais
title.en: future forms: aller + infinitive, futur simple, present, j'aimerais

explain.ko: 미래를 말하는 방법은 여러 가지입니다. aller + 동사원형 (je vais déménager)은 이미 정한 계획, futur simple (j'économiserai)는 약속이나 즉흥적 결정, 현재형 (je rencontre un ami demain à 15 h)은 확정된 일정, j'aimerais + 동사원형은 소망을 나타냅니다.
explain.en: There are several ways to talk about the future. Aller + infinitive (je vais déménager) is for decided plans, the futur simple (j'économiserai) for promises and quick decisions, the present (je rencontre un ami demain à 15 h) for fixed arrangements and j'aimerais + infinitive for wishes.

head: 표현 / Structure

notes.ko: 정한 계획 = aller, 약속 = futur simple.
notes.en: Decided plan = aller; promise = futur simple.
A fixed arrangement can use the present.

lines.t: Quels sont tes projets pour l'avenir ?

trans.en: (Question) What are your plans for the future?

lines.t: Que vas-tu faire après ton diplôme ?
Je vais déménager à Paris. J'ai l'intention d'y trouver un travail.
Je rencontre un ami à trois heures. Un jour, tu aimerais devenir écrivain, non ?

trans.ko:
A: 졸업하면 뭐 할 거야?
B: 파리로 이사할 거야. 거기서 직업을 구할 계획이야.
A: 내일은 뭐 해?
B: 3시에 친구를 만나. 너는 언젠가 작가가 되고 싶어 하잖아?
trans.en:
A: What are you going to do after you graduate?
B: I'm going to move to Paris. I plan to get a job there.
A: What are you doing tomorrow?
B: I'm meeting a friend at three. You'd like to be a writer one day, wouldn't you?

lines.t: Je m'appelle Eva. J'obtiens mon diplôme l'année prochaine. Après mon diplôme, je vais déménager à Paris et trouver un travail. J'économiserai aussi de l'argent. Un jour, j'aimerais devenir écrivain. Je promets de travailler dur.

trans.ko: 제 이름은 에바예요. 저는 내년에 졸업해요. 졸업하면 파리로 이사해서 직업을 구할 거예요. 돈도 저축할 거예요. 언젠가 작가가 되고 싶어요. 열심히 하겠다고 약속해요.
trans.en: My name is Eva. I graduate next year. After I graduate I'm going to move to Paris and get a job. I'll save money too. One day I'd like to be a writer. I promise to work hard.

trans.en:
